modules.module_title: Adhere to industry, regulatory, and organizational standards and embrace environmentally sustainable practices

pcs.pc_description: Execute job responsibilities according to organizational standards, with a strong emphasis on eco-friendly solutions, while strictly adhering to established procedures, policies, and legal regulations.
Implement and uphold organizational policies and procedures, integrating sustainable consumption practices into daily operations.
Actively engage in enhancing organizational performance by driving the transition towards environmentally friendly processes and practices.
Safely handle materials, equipment, computers, and software to maintain a clean and hazard-free work environment, actively supporting the adoption of eco-friendly practices throughout the workplace.
Perform routine maintenance and cleaning tasks within assigned duties and agreed-upon schedules, effectively managing any interruptions to workflow.
Immediately report any instances of unsafe equipment or hazardous incidents to the appropriate personnel to ensure swift resolution and mitigate risks.
Utilize appropriate cleaning equipment and techniques tailored to specific tasks, promoting efficiency and sustainability in workplace maintenance.
Proactively request system or software upgrades as necessary to optimize work efficiency, while also maintaining backup files to ensure data integrity and security when using various design software.
Maintain digital copies of design work in organized files for future reference, ensuring accessibility and preservation of valuable project assets.
